rows.ARS:
Deep pink Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: Parade (climber, Boerner 1953)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Eugene S. Boerner (United States, 1953).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (Newark, NY) in 1953 as 'Parade'.
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1954 as 'Parade'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. 33 petals. Large, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing.

Height: 7' to 12' (215 to 365cm). Width: up to 8' (up to 245cm).
